reviewer: authoring assistant; self-review, not independent owner review
scope: Exact selected files, schemas/projections, dependency structure and explanation alignment.

findings.finding: One user review was confused with one subject Evaluation.
findings.disposition: This package is one consolidated proposal covering five meanings. Each later Evaluation still binds one exact Definition version. Package review is not a production Evaluation receipt.

findings.finding: Meaning, profile contract, executed evidence and authority effect could collapse.
findings.disposition: Model separates the five meanings, two concrete profiles, Evaluation records, owner decisions, application receipts and visible Project State.

findings.finding: Pending owner reviews could appear closed by the instruction to prepare everything.
findings.disposition: All three mapping scopes remain unselected; actual v1 checks 06/07 retain NOT_EVALUABLE. Preparation authorization records no owner concurrence.

findings.finding: v1 lifecycle full-PASS wording can be mistaken for the pre-decision eligibility rule.
findings.disposition: No lifecycle transition is inferred from checks 01-05 or a conditional 01-06 PASS. Current v1 admission rule remains exact; its lifecycle gate interpretation needs applicable owner disposition at execution. Proposed v2 explicitly names phase gates without modifying v1.

findings.finding: The two-meaning and full-cohort postimages have different counts and authority representations.
findings.disposition: 191/185 is conditional two-meaning bootstrap; 194/187 is prospective full five-meaning cohort. Current 189/183 remains unchanged. v1 authoring labels are conditional values, with metadata required to recover actual standing.

findings.finding: Older carrier/activation drafts refer to candidate.1 meanings.
findings.disposition: The consolidated model selects the frozen step-09 candidate.3 activation and registration material, preserving older drafts as history.

findings.finding: An incident predicate can fail even when a Definition is structurally valid.
findings.disposition: Illustration separates coverage assessment from Definition evaluation; retains account, filters, snapshot, output and noncoverage exclusions. The specimen is excluded from the five-meaning admission cohort.

findings.finding: Schema checks and finite semantic evidence could be overstated as full conformance.
findings.disposition: Fresh checks cover integrity, structure, projection and selected dependency consistency. Prior formal conclusions remain bounded; runtime qualification and all 17 assurance follow-ups remain open.

findings.finding: Existing runnable CLI could be confused with completion of strict M1 integration.
findings.disposition: Existing legacy Lab CLI and its context/graph/review/compiler bindings are retained. Strict pack adapter, provider/exporter and application qualification remain explicit implementation work.

findings.finding: A single review could imply one principal has every authority scope.
findings.disposition: One presentation collects independent scope outcomes. Existing assignments are evidence of their declared scope; future v2 and Product effect applicability still requires explicit verification.
